title: MemoryError Display echoes client-supplied state token / blob id
description: Found during JMAP-510h.37. The JmapBackend::Error Display contract (crate-jmap-server/src/backend.rs) forbids PII-shaped data. crate-jmap-mail-server/src/memory/mod.rs builds MemoryError::new(format!("invalid state token: {since_state}")) (~line 654) and MemoryError::new(format!("blob not found: {blob_id}")) (~line 1612): both strings come from the request and can hold arbitrary client text, which then lands in operator logs. Decide whether to drop the value (as JMAP-510h.37 did for serde errors) or bound/escape it, change the canonical mail-server first, then sweep siblings for MemoryError::new(format!(...{request field}...)).
close_reason: Batch 21 (run wf_18048230-8ff): implemented, adversarially verified; CI green except new cargo-deny advisory RUSTSEC-2026-0387 (crypto-bigint 0.5.5, unrelated to these changes) at 741292f0; beqc spec commits 639dc1d/7787c51 in jmap-chat-spec (not pushed)
